mil5.3.10:1.2: Mamaṃ vā bhikkhave pare vaṇṇaṃ bhāseyyuṃ dhammassa vā - sanghassa vā vaṇṇaṃ bhāseyyuṃ, tatra tumhehi na ānando na somanassaṃ na cetaso ubbillāvitattaṃ karaṇīyan-ti. Puna ca Tathāgato Selassa brāhmaṇassa yathābhucce vaṇṇe bhaññamāne ānandito sumano ubbillāvito bhiyyo uttariṃ sakaguṇaṃ pakittesi:
mil5.3.10:3.2: Mamaṃ vā bhikkhave pare vaṇṇaṃ bhāseyyuṃ dhammassa vā sanghassa vā vaṇṇaṃ bhāseyyuṃ, tatra tumhehi na ānando na somanassaṃ na cetaso ubbillāvitattaṃ karaṇīyan-ti, tena hi: Selassa brāhmaṇassa yathābhucce vaṇṇe bhaññamāne ānandito sumano ubbillāvito bhiyyo uttariṃ sakaguṇaṃ pakittesīti yaṃ vacanaṃ taṃ micchā.
mil5.3.10:3.3: Yadi Selassa brāhmanassa yathābhucce vaṇṇe bhaññamāne ānandito sumano ubbillāvito bhiyyo uttariṃ sakaguṇaṃ pakittesi, tena hi: Mamaṃ vā bhikkhave pare vaṇṇaṃ bhāseyyuṃ dhammassa vā - sanghassa vā vaṇṇaṃ bhāseyyuṃ, tatra tumhehi na ānando na somanassaṃ na cetaso ubbillāvitattaṃ karaṇīyan-ti tam-pi vacanaṃ micchā.
mil5.3.10:3.4: Ayam-pi ubhatokoṭiko pañho tavānuppatto, so tayā nibbāhitabbo ti.
mil5.3.10:4.2: Mamaṃ vā bhikkhave pare vaṇṇaṃ bhāseyyuṃ dhammassa vā sanghassa vā vaṇṇaṃ bhāseyyuṃ, tatra tumhehi na ānando na somanassaṃ na cetaso ubbillāvitattaṃ karaṇīyan-ti.
mil5.3.10:4.3: Selassa ca brāhmaṇassa yathābhucce vaṇṇe bhaññamāne bhiyyo uttariṃ sakaguṇaṃ pakittitaṃ:
mil5.3.10:6.1: Paṭhamaṃ mahārāja Bhagavatā dhammassa sabhāvasarasa-lakkhaṇaṃ sabhāvaṃ avitathaṃ bhūtaṃ tacchaṃ tathatthaṃ paridīpayamānena bhaṇitaṃ:
mil5.3.10:6.2: Mamaṃ vā bhikkhave pare vaṇṇaṃ bhāseyyuṃ dhammassa vāsanghassa vā vaṇṇaṃ bhāseyyuṃ, tatra tumhehi na ānando na somanassaṃ na cetaso ubbillāvitattaṃ karaṇīyan-ti.
mil5.3.10:6.3: Yaṃ pana Bhagavatā Selassa brāhmaṇassa yathābhucce vaṇṇe bhaññamāne bhiyyo uttariṃ sakaguṇaṃ pakittitaṃ:
mil5.3.10:6.4: Rājā 'ham-asmi Sela dhammarājā anuttaro ti, taṃ na lābhahetu na yasahetu na pakkhahetu na antevāsikamyatāya, atha kho anukampāya kāruññena hitavasena: evaṃ imassa dhammābhisamayo bhavissati tiṇṇañ-ca māṇavakasatānan-ti, evaṃ bhiyyo uttariṃ sakaguṇaṃ bhaṇitaṃ:
mil5.3.10:6.6: Sādhu bhante Nāgasena, evam-etaṃ, tathā sampaṭicchāmīti.
